content.body: Do you know why https://github.com/advisories?query=CVE-2024-43357 doesn't find anything?
I would expect it to show https://github.com/tc39/ecma262/security/advisories/GHSA-g38c-wh3c-5h9r
It also does not auto-link in GitHub issues
because the advisory database is missing the record entirely ☹️

from Walter at GSMA:

>  I will attend the next meeting and will prepare tutorial about data channel architecture and the JavaScript distribution and execution environment  . Just for information and I don't expect anybody to read the documents . GSMA NG.129 white paper document (already few years old) available from https://www.gsma.com/newsroom/wp-content/uploads//NG.129-V1.2.pdf summarizes the local JavaScript execution environment on page 77 (Figure B.1.2-2) and page 53 (Figure A.2.2.1-1) shows simplified network architecture with Data Channel Server that is kind of Application Server controlled by operator that hosts the JavaScript/HTML/CSS content.  And NG.134 https://www.gsma.com/newsroom/gsma_resources/ng-134-ims-data-channel-v3-0/ is the document that gives strict technical guidance how networks and devices should implement the functionality for global interoperability . I will explain all of this next week.

GSMA NG.129 white paper document (already few years old) available from https://www.gsma.com/newsroom/wp-content/uploads//NG.129-V1.2.pdf summarizes the local JavaScript execution environment on page 77 (Figure B.1.2-2) and page 53 (Figure A.2.2.1-1) shows simplified network architecture with Data Channel Server that is kind of Application Server controlled by operator that hosts the JavaScript/HTML/CSS content. And NG.134 https://www.gsma.com/newsroom/gsma_resources/ng-134-ims-data-channel-v3-0/ is the document that gives strict technical guidance how networks and devices should implement the functionality for global interoperability .
